# Jesus Raises a Widow’s Son (Luke 7:14)

## Emotional Focus
When a family feels sad and needs Jesus’ comfort and power.

## Key KJV
“Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.” (Luke 7:14)

## Gentle Retelling
A widow’s only son had died. As they carried him out of the city, Jesus met them. He touched the coffin and said, “Young man, arise!” The son sat up and Jesus gave him back to his mother.

## Coloring Prompt
Jesus touching a simple coffin while the young man sits up; mother watching with happy tears.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Jesus brings hope and life even when everything feels lost.”
